HomePage.title: ROKIO – Process Analysis for SMEs
HomePage.description: Employees share, AI brings it together, the team decides the first step.

Kopf.logoAlt: ROKIO – Find the right AI and robotics solutions together

Home.ueberzeile: ROKIO · Robotics and AI for SMEs
Home.titel: Your people know where it gets stuck
Home.einleitung: ROKIO asks everyone in your business in five minutes on their phone, makes visible where handovers are losing time – and shows which AI and robotics solutions help exactly there. Right through to a ready-made blueprint.
Home.karteHinweis: Handover map of a fictional metalwork business

anlegen.text: Management names the departments, a rough hourly rate range and the date of the results meeting. ROKIO gets to know the business and prepares fitting questions.

erzaehlen.text: Each person taps where it gets stuck and tells their story – including by voice. ROKIO asks at most once more. Anonymous, no names.

loesen.text: The analysis shows the breaking points between departments and what they cost. Then: AI and robotics solutions tailored to this business, with a blueprint for self-setup.

metallbau.stimme: We built a railing from the old drawing.
metallbau.loesung: Change agent: A change is said once and is correct everywhere.

pflege.stimme: During handover everyone speaks quickly and uses abbreviations.
pflege.loesung: Handover assistant: in any language, without abbreviations.

mensa.stimme: Between twelve and two the conveyor belt overflows.
mensa.loesung: Returns with eyes: The dishroom reports what was cooked too much.

Home.ehrlich: Honestly labelled: maturity and source are listed on every solution, 'verified by ROKI' only with a source. The demo uses fictional businesses; in real use the AI runs locally and in compliance with data protection.

Eingabe.fehler: Speaking didn't work ({grund}). You can also type.

Begriffe.herkunftHinweisUngeprueft: General assessment – check before making a decision.

Anlegen.einleitung: Three minutes. Then ROKIO prepares the survey for your business and you receive a code for your team.
